thread:
Mia Chong: quick thought — can we add a "diff coverage" check in the console before allowing promotions to prod? had two rollouts this month where a small flag change routed 20% more traffic to a path with stale quotas.
Devon Patel: +1. show me % of routes impacted, sample count, and estimated token cost delta.
Samir Rao: also run a shadow/dry-run against recent traffic slice and report error delta / p95 latency delta. even a rough estimate is helpful.
Kevin Li: UI wise: small modal on 'Promote to prod' that lists failures + a red/amber/green coverage metric. allow ops to 'force promote' with ack.
Mia Chong: love the modal. proposal: compute three things for preview: (1) route coverage (fraction of traffic that would see the change), (2) quota/throughput impact per-route, (3) telemetry regressions from dry-run. We can gate promotion if coverage > X and regression > Y.
Devon Patel: what should X/Y be by default? thinking X = 0.01 (1%) for risky changes? or X = 0.05 for low-risk UI flags. maybe make it configurable per-flag-criticality.
Samir Rao: default gating: block if regression p95 latency increases > 10% OR error-rate odds ratio > 2. metrics over a 24h window of sampled traffic.
Kevin Li: implementation idea — add preview API: POST /api/v1/configs/{id}/preview with body: 
```json
{
  "sample_fraction": 0.05,
  "dry_run": true,
  "lookback_hours": 24
}
```
returns coverage %, estimated token delta, list of changed routes + sample traces. opsbot can trigger it from CI.
OpsBot: triggered job preview-1754321000 by @Mia Chong — status: queued -> running -> completed. output attached (summary): coverage=3.2%, est_token_delta=+12k, p95_delta=+2.1%
Mia Chong: nice. question: where do we calculate coverage? console side (fast approximate hash) or runtime (ground truth)?
Devon Patel: do a two-step: console approximation (100ms) then runtime sample (background job) to validate. show both numbers and the runtime TTL for validation.
Samir Rao: perf note — runtime sample job should cap to N requests per minute to avoid load. also store deterministic sample seed so preview is reproducible.
Kevin Li: UX: show 'approx coverage (fast)' and 'validated coverage (slow)'. prevent promote if validated coverage > threshold and telemetry gate trips. allow force-promote with reason required (audit log).
Mia Chong: agree. can we also wire this into rollouts so canary cohorts automatically use the same sample seed? reduces drift.
Devon Patel: yes — use cohort id and sample seed in rollout config. make default canary size 2% and allow console quick-adjust.
Samir Rao: followups: add unit that estimates cost delta per hour/day and a quick 'safety score' combining coverage, cost delta, and telemetry risk.
Kevin Li: I'll prototype the preview API + modal. I'll add a small checkbox "require validated coverage". target: prototype in staging by end of week. assigning to @Kevin Li.
Mia Chong: thx — can we also add a telemetry playbook link in the modal (docs on how to interpret p95/error deltas)?
Kevin Li: will add docs + a tooltip explaining thresholds.
Devon Patel: sounds good. QA: @Samir Rao can you help define the gate thresholds and sampling caps?
Samir Rao: yup, will send a short RFC with thresholds and CI job knobs.
Mia Chong: awesome. not blocking rollout today but please post status in #eng-platform when prototype lands. :thumbsup:
Kevin Li: will do.
OpsBot: job preview-1754321000 artifact: https://ci.internal/jobs/1754321000/preview-summary.json
Mia Chong: noted, thanks everyone.
